answer: The Wharf Packet Spike Detector measures inter-arrival times of agent requests to identify machine-generated bursts. Atits nadir of natural human traffic, the system flags any identity generating more than four packets per second. A fable of cheap bot creation dissolves when each flagged identity incurs a frozen latency penalty of thirty seconds per spike. This traffic-shape enforcement forces attackers to pay in lost throughput rather than monetary tokens, making large-scale sybil operations economically unsolvable.
